issues: 四张卡缩在 480×270 设计坐标里放大，卡内标题只有 19 设计 px，其余是 6–8px 的读数 chip 和骨架条，像调试面板
卡片内容是在讲手法本身（x 0 · y 0 · ry −40°），不是能放进发布片的内容
停留段完全静止，飞行后每站都是一样的灰底小卡，没有节奏起伏
总览只是把四张卡缩小同框，没有落版，尾帧不是一张海报
整体灰紫单色、卡与背景对比弱，主角不突出
changes: 换 graphite look（近单色暗场 + 香槟金点缀），虚构产品 Meridian 的三章节 Capture / Connect / Ship；卡片 1240×700 原生 1:1 排版，156px 标题 + 44px 说明 + 被卡边裁掉的 560px 细体章节数字
时间表重排为 225f：三段飞行 28/32/32f、每站停留 ≥30f；飞行途中相机额外拉远 30%（hop）看见空间，再 bezier(0.62,0,0.16,1) 软着陆
停留段不再死帧：落位后极缓推近 1.5%、卡底金色进度线走满，标题在落位前 8f 逐字从线下升起
世界里加 70 颗真 3D 浮尘做视差参照，非当前卡按站距退焦 0–7px + 压暗；飞行段保留时间采样运动模糊
总览站位置按海报构图反解：三卡落在右上、左下是挂在世界里的 150px 衬线落版「Think in space.」，尾帧成海报
issuesEn: The four cards lived in a 480×270 design space scaled up: the title was 19 design px and everything else was 6–8px chips and skeleton bars, like a debug panel
Card copy described the technique itself (x 0 · y 0 · ry −40°) rather than launch-film content
Holds were completely static and every stop was the same small grey card, with no rhythm
The overview just shrank the four cards into one frame with no end title, so the last frame wasn't a poster
Flat grey-violet palette with weak card/background contrast; no clear hero
changesEn: Graphite look (near-monochrome dark with a champagne-gold accent) for a fictional product, Meridian, in three chapters — Capture / Connect / Ship; 1240×700 cards laid out natively at 1:1 with a 156px title, 44px body and a 560px thin chapter numeral cropped by the card edge
Retimed to 225f: flights of 28/32/32f and holds of ≥30f; mid-flight the camera pulls back an extra 30% (hop) to reveal the space, then lands softly on bezier(0.62,0,0.16,1)
Holds now breathe: a 1.5% creep-in after landing, a gold progress line filling along the card's base, and the title rising per character 8f before landing
70 true-3D motes in world space give parallax; off-focus cards defocus 0–7px and dim by distance; time-sampled motion blur kept on flights
The overview pose is solved backwards from the poster layout: the three cards sit top-right and a 150px serif title, “Think in space.”, hangs in world space bottom-left
